notes: Synthetic MyInvois/UBL 2.1 sample (not a real LHDN-issued e-invoice — no real sample was available). Parsed by idp/ubl_invoice.py directly from the XML tree, bypassing extract.py's regex entirely, since the source is already fully structured. Exercises the same gate.score_extraction() path as every other deterministic source, with ocr_confidence=None (no OCR involved) scored as a clean 1.0 per gate.py's documented behavior. Line item (qty=2, unitPrice=100.00, amount=200.00) reconciles exactly against LegalMonetaryTotal/PayableAmount, so the math-audit component also scores 1.0. Real MyInvois-specific extensions (LHDN validation UUID/QR under cac:AdditionalDocumentReference) are not read by this first slice — see ubl_invoice.py's module docstring.
